propositions: autodeploy recreates compose-review-bot-1 without draining in-flight reviews, killing code review mid-execution when main advances and bot source changes

during a landing burst with deploy gaps shorter than review duration (~10 min), recreations interrupt reviews faster than the self-heal reconciler can retry, causing the LLM-Review gate to live-lock with zero votes despite all health signals reading OK

the bot's graceful shutdown drain protects webhook-queued reviews but not the reconciler's inline review_and_vote path, which is the path that retries killed reviews and gets re-killed by the next deploy

the VOTER_ERROR alarm cannot detect this failure mode because killed reviews emit no error — nothing failed, the process was asked to stop — so the gate can be fully live-locked while every monitoring signal stays green

solution defers deploys when in_flight > 0 (keyed to episode, bounded at 1800s to prevent indefinite blocking) and emits AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED and AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT metrics so the blind spot becomes observable via a new paging alarm
